slots.phase-detail-visual/phase-sidebar/conten: Demonstrate that one priority customer journey can operate across application, integration and data boundaries with agreed service controls. Use the working slice to validate reusable patterns, expose constraints and establish the evidence needed for a controlled release. Observe the first journey and map state ownership, handoffs, decisions, and exception paths.

Build the vertical slice with automated checks and deployment controls.
Exercise reconciliation, telemetry, security and recovery scenarios.
